contracts.procedure: Reproduce consumer growth against the pinned 4.0 baseline in disposable projects, repair the semantic boundary, then run positive and negative graph/proof CLI scenarios with actual files, stored proofs, guards and event heads. Preserve the baseline failure; inspect actual transitions and unchanged history. Do not replace source coverage with status fixtures.

not_applicable.visual: These claims concern CLI/state and instruction decisions, not a rendered UI. Missing-visual cases must refuse visual acceptance; any later rendered-interface change needs its own capture and actual review.

contracts.environment: Disposable local projects and owned test processes; no production, personal credentials or existing installations. Record candidate, runtime, host/model identity when applicable. Failed/not-run observations remain visible.

run.environment: Disposable local projects and owned test processes; no production, personal credentials or existing installations. Record candidate, runtime, host/model identity when applicable. Failed/not-run observations remain visible.

instruction: Capture this template BEFORE the checks. Execute or inspect the stated procedure; never invent observations. Source inputs must remain unchanged through submission.
